observations: Photo 0 is a professional stock image or digital render of a welding machine.
The image contains a watermark 'MURICH INVESTMENTS'.
The brand 'INGCO' is clearly visible on the front and side panels.
The text '500A' and 'MMA' are visible on the machine.
The machine features a digital display, adjustment knobs, and heavy-duty terminals.
Technical specifications '380-400V~50/60Hz' are printed at the top of the image.
Icons for 'Arc-force', 'Hot Start', and 'Anti Sticking' are shown at the bottom.
An 'IGBT Inverter Technology' seal is in the bottom right corner.

claims.evidence: The brand and amperage match the photo, but the specific model number suffix 'ING-MMA5008' is not legible on the machine in the stock photo.
Photo 0 shows '500A' printed on the machine.
This is a marketing descriptor not verifiable from a stock photo.
The 'MMA' (Manual Metal Arc) designation indicates electrode welding.

risks.proof: Photos of the actual unit from multiple angles, including the serial number plate.
A video showing the machine powered on and performing a test weld.
A photo showing the electrode holder, earth clamp, and cables.
risks.if_unproven: as the machine unit only, without necessary cables

proof_requests: Photos of the actual welding machine being sold, not stock images.
A photo of the specification plate on the back or side of the actual unit.
A video of the machine powered on and welding.
Photos of the included welding cables and clamps.
response.reason: The seller has provided only a stock marketing image. Real photos of the actual item are required to verify its existence, condition, and specific model before a price can be determined.
